slogan_filter.think_again: Do not assume more rendering equals better communication. Re-check what the viewer must understand.
slogan_filter.keep_your_key: Source geometry, confirmed semantics, revision identity and unresolved source content remain protected.
slogan_filter.find_a_way: Use vector, raster, model-first, AI or hybrid methods according to the source and target output.
slogan_filter.youre_the_key: Final quality is judged by the intended human use at actual A3 output size.

quality_dimensions.rule: Cut/primary/secondary/context line classes must be visually distinguishable.
quality_dimensions.evidence: Architectural drawing conventions and repeated practitioner feedback.

quality_dimensions.rule: Empty space is allowed and preferred when it improves hierarchy; do not fill the sheet merely to appear rich.
Texture modules must be plausible at drawing scale; overscaled wood/tile/stone is NEEDS_REVISION.
The primary drawing/view must be identifiable before supporting diagrams and text.
Related information should form a readable macro-to-micro or concept-to-detail sequence.
Furniture/people/vegetation are communication devices for use and scale, not decoration that obscures architecture.
Cut plane dominates; near/mid/far information steps down in visual weight.
Text/dimensions/labels use consistent hierarchy and remain legible at A3 proof size.
Color supports hierarchy or program/material reading and does not compete with source linework.
Lighting, shadow and grain are optional; remove them when they reduce legibility.

proof_rule.numeric_score_role: comparison experiments only; never proof of architectural correctness
